digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / G7 criteria routing and blocking
propositions: G7 routing entry default_posture must change from 'advisory' at 0.95 to 'blocking' at 0.85 to activate blocking for verified high-priority findings (348 historical findings show zero false positives at priority >= 0.85).

Plan-review blocking derives solely from default_posture == 'blocking' and block_threshold via threshold_for(gate='plan_review'), not per-grade Pass-3 machinery; contradicts_reality and omits_required_site hard-floor impact at 0.85 while incomplete_enumeration caps at 0.55 and cannot block.

G7 rubric must add four guidance rules: abstain-with-coverage on unresolvable parent (never a finding), closed-parent final-state check with sibling-handoff carve-out, dedup-at-source (one finding per contradicted clause), and floor-kind guidance (only genuine contract contradictions or provably required omissions block).

Pinned blocking-set assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py, test_impact_model_versioning.py, and test_plan_review_g7.py must reflect G7 at (0.85, 'blocking'); test_plan_review_g7.py posture pin must update from advisory@0.95 to blocking@0.85.

New test suite tests/unit/plan_review/test_g7_blocking.py must verify real Pass-3 orchestrator with real impact_plan: contradicts_reality all-yes blocks, omites_required_site all-yes blocks, incomplete_enumeration all-yes stays advisory at 0.55, and boundary case at priority 0.85 blocks.

Documentation regenerate via `python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide` and commit; monitoring follow-up records FP classification recheck once >= 20 kind-graded G7 findings accumulate in REVIEW_RESULT corpus.
